newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end off, gains seen limited.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end off, gains seen limited.

text.p: 1325 GMT - Austrian shares end the week softer after an uneventful session. Traders expect a friendly market next week but see gains limited to 1,310.
* ATX down 1.24 pts or 0.10 pct at 1,295.04
* 10 ATX gainers outweigh eight decliners, three unchanged
* Top gainer AMS, up 1.57 pct at 1,035 ATS
* Leading loser OMV, down 1.27 pct at 1,556 ATS
* July ATX futures down 7.2 pts at 1,298.8 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
